Ah look, as you have most likely heard by now, this is not as good as the first two films and it's just a little bit tired in formula. However, it's still a bunch of fun if you already buy into the fastest mouth/fastest hands pairing of Chris Tucker and Jackie Chan.

Arguably works as an example of the sort of red flags one might want to look out for if they suspect that a film's director is (like Brett Ratner) a sex offender. But as a movie? Nah, not so much. Final rating:★ - Of no value. Avoid at all costs.

Rush Hour 2 is the follow up to the box office hit Rush Hour. With Chris Tucker and Jackie Chan being an unlikely duo, they no doubt continue on their on screen chemistry and bounce off each other with more jokes and energy this time around. This franchise absolutely gets better with every movie!
